objdata.Name: 聚能山竹史诗任务 - 第三关

NameMultiLanguage.zh: 聚能山竹史诗任务 - 第三关

Lines.en: SansGrinder just gave me a whole lotta taco!
Lines.zh: 衫竹刚才给我了一大堆玉米卷！

Lines.en: heya I might or might not have assassinated zomboss lol
Lines.zh: 嗨呀我说我一不小心把僵王刺杀了你信吗XD
你是……衫竹？你这是怎么做到的？

Lines.en: i perma-stunned him and he can't move unless i wish him to lol
Lines.zh: 我用5阶技能给他永控了 =)

Lines.en: Does that mean there will be no more zombies today?
Lines.zh: 那今天是不是就没有僵尸了？

Lines.en: enjoy your tacos, for it might be your LAST MEAL >=)
Lines.zh: 好好享用你最后的玉米卷吧 >=)

Lines.en: Warning! I've detected considerable amounts of machinery approaching!
Lines.zh: 警告！我检测到了大量机甲接近！

Lines.en: I suppose a taco wouldn't hurt
You! Yes, I mean you! I can feel you behind that screen!
Lines.zh: 你！对，就是你！ 是的我能看到你！

Lines.en: I wrote you several puzzles to solve, their answers being zombies to watch out for
Lines.zh: 我给你写了几个谜题，谜题的答案是你需要额外注意的僵尸

Lines.en: If you can beat my challenge, I'll help you out tomorrow and give you my beloved mangosteen
Lines.zh: 如果你能通过我的挑战，那么我明天会帮你渡过难关并把我的5阶山竹送你

Lines.en: As for now, happy april fools and have fun... NOT >=)
Lines.zh: 愚人节快乐，祝你玩的开心……才怪！>=)

BriefIntroduction.zh: 跨越了设备，跨越了平台，跨越了整个互联网，只为拯救你！
BriefIntroduction.en: This mangosteen travelled all the way from pvz2c across the entire internet just to save your life on this fierce battlefield!

BriefIntroduction.zh: 只是一只最普通的山竹……
你们好啊，新人进群先打bloominghearts_4 FOR EVERYONE 重制版.json
BriefIntroduction.en:
First things first, beat 
"bloominghearts_4 FOR EVERYONE 重制版.json"!

NAME.zh: 电 能 大 哥

BriefIntroduction.en: Diabolically shreds Zombies with Electric Peas!

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Survive SansGrinder's belated April Fools prank!
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 在衫竹的迟来的愚人节整蛊中生存下来！

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Most decks are unbeatable without PF!
The sphinx's sun riddle: who in AE hates repeater the most?
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 狮身终结者的阳光谜题：神秘埃及中谁最讨厌双重射手？

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: The wagon's health riddle: who in WW has the lowest health?
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 战争牛车的血量谜题：狂野西部中谁的生命值最低？

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Dark Dragon's combo riddle: which DA combo greatly threatens your frontline?
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 黑暗巨龙的组合谜题：哪个黑暗时代组合可以对你的前排构成巨大威胁？

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Historical-tron's zomboss riddle: which zomboss has the least health?
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 历史重塑者的僵王谜题：哪种僵王的血量最低？

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Blade master's summoning riddle: which zombie weilds the power of 2 different zombies, yet does it better?
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 持刀大侠的召唤谜题：哪个僵尸拥有两种不同僵尸的能力，却又做得更好？
